connection_fields.name: url
connection_fields.description: complete JDBC URL or minimal vendor URL; may contain credentials

connection_fields.name: driver_jars
connection_fields.description: local driver JAR path, or a list of paths; vendor drivers are user-supplied

connection_fields.name: driver_class
connection_fields.description: optional fully qualified JDBC driver class instead of service discovery

connection_fields.name: properties
connection_fields.description: arbitrary case-sensitive vendor settings with string, boolean or numeric values
